nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## SDR footage → HDR remaster (RUDRA AI Fill) Workflow for Radiance:

1. Read: an 8-bit video, image sequence or still.
2. SDR to HDR Universal expands to scene-linear (1.0 = 203 nits) and outputs reconstructed_mask. Mode Hybrid with learned_backend Auto runs RUDRA ACES 2 on every frame (batch_mode Video Frames also smooths the knee over time).
3. AI fill prompts (RUDRA) looks at the frames and suggests what is in the blown areas (a sky, the sun, a lamp), or pick one of its 9 presets; it says whether the prompt is already cached. Its prompt drives AI Fill. To type your own, add text in extra, or right-click AI Fill > convert prompt_highlight back to a widget.
4. SDR to HDR AI Fill (RUDRA v3) regenerates detail inside blown highlights (Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B + FXTD LoRA, 16 GB GPU, downloads on first run).
5. Hold steady within each shot (RUDRA) stops the HDR breathing from frame to frame; it resets at cuts. Set its fps to the source's.
6. Flicker report measures what is left, per shot, in EV (warns above 0.1 EV).
7. CDL: trim the remaster.
8. EXR 16-bit half master, HDR10 MP4 (PQ) and SDR MP4 via ACES 2.0. For a still, switch the Write formats to IMG and bypass Hold and Flicker (Ctrl+B); set fps on the Writes if the source is not 24 fps.
Viewer: remaster vs source. Small viewer: where AI Fill generated pixels.

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

The models download themselves into `ComfyUI/models/radiance` on the first run: nothing to install.

**RUDRA ACES 2** (Apache 2.0, about 3 MB) and **RUDRA AI fill v3** (Apache 2.0, 271 MB)
- [fxtdstudios/rudra-models](https://huggingface.co/fxtdstudios/rudra-models), folders `models/RUDRA_ACES_2` and `models/rudra_genfill_v3`
**Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B** (Wan-AI, Apache 2.0, 7.7 GB), the AI fill's base model
- [Wan-AI/Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B-diffusers](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B-diffusers)
- Its umT5 text encoder (11.4 GB) downloads only the first time a custom prompt is encoded.

## Model Storage Location (loaded files)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   └── 📂 radiance/
│       ├── 📂 RUDRA_ACES_2/
│       ├── 📂 rudra_genfill_v3/
│       └── 📂 Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B-diffusers/
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
